features_100ms.spectral_window: Hann 100 ms, zero-padded to 8192 FFT points at 48 kHz; spectral resolution about 10 Hz
features_100ms.drive_normalisation: sqrt band power / track p95, clipped 0..1 independently per band
features_100ms.harmonic_proxy: median-filter mask energy proxy, 128 ms STFT at 16 kHz; not true harmonic purity

limitations: BPM and phase estimated from mixed audio; grid is not an exact drum annotation.
